annotations.title: 米国の資材の流通の各段の価格

description: 米国で建材や化学品が流通の各段でいくらになるかを計算して返す: 輸入の陸揚げ原価(Census の輸入統計、CIF + 関税、232 条などの追加関税を含む)から、卸(業種の平均の粗利率、Census AIES 2024)、小売(直接輸入と卸経由の幅)、元請(Caltrans の材料の上乗せ 15%)まで。HS 10 桁か英語の品名で引く。各行に式・出典の URL と sha256・卸の業種の当て方の確度・BEA 2007 の流通構造との照合が付く。推計(computed:true)で、見積の良し悪しを判定する値ではない。例: query='plywood'、hs='2523290000'(ポルトランドセメント)。 / Estimated U.S. prices along the distribution chain for construction materials and chemicals: landed import cost (Census, CIF plus duty including Section 232) to wholesale (industry-average gross margin, Census AIES 2024), retail (range: direct import vs via wholesale) and contractor (Caltrans materials markup 15%). Look up by HS code or English product name; every row carries the formula, source URLs and hashes, mapping confidence and a BEA 2007 cross-check. Estimates (computed:true), not a verdict on any quote.

hs.description: HS の頭 2〜10 桁(例 2523 セメント、4412 合板、3917 樹脂管、6907 タイル)。 / HS code prefix.

include_thin.description: 取引の薄い品目も入れる(既定は外す)。 / Include thinly traded items.

query.description: 英語の品名(例 plywood, portland cement, pvc pipe, ceramic tiles)。 / Product name in English.

name: get_us_price_chain

outputSchema.description: 米国の流通の各段の推計(計算して返す)。 / U.S. distribution-chain estimates, computed on request.

count.description: How many records matched. 0 means the source was read and nothing matched. It never means the source could not be read, that returns isError: true.

did_you_mean.description: Near matches, when an exact match was not found.

how_to_cite.description: 引用の仕方 / how to cite

lookup.description: ok = the source was read and something matched. absent = the source was read and nothing matched. A source that could NOT be read never appears here: that returns isError: true and makes no claim about what does or does not exist.

markups.description: 元請の上乗せ率(州の交通局の原本) / contractor markups from state DOT originals

rows.description: 品目ごとの陸揚げ・卸・小売・元請(式・出典・sha256) / landed, wholesale, retail, contractor with formula and sources

source_read.description: true on every successful result. A failed lookup does not return a result at all, so this is never false, it is declared so a consumer can assert on it.

title: Get U.S. Material Price Chain (landed import cost to wholesale, retail and contractor)
